# What this notebook does

Kate, 2026-10-30. MDA-MB-231, eIF3d regression models (intrinsic sequence features, outcome =
raw TE change log2(sictrl / si3d)). For each gene and each of three features (5'UTR length, CDS
length, GC3), its SHAP value in the **normoxia 1+4hr (time-regressed)** model (x) against its SHAP
value in the **hypoxia 1hr** model (y). One dot per gene.

- **SHAP source:** the out-of-fold SHAP files (`shap_oof_*.rds`), which explain every one of the
  10,172 modelled genes from a forest that did not train on it. The full-feature model only has
  SHAP for a 200-gene explain set, so it is not used.
- **Raw SHAP:** the contribution to the predicted TE change, in log2 units.
- **Normalized SHAP:** each value divided by that gene's total |SHAP| over all 57 features in that
  model (as in the SHAP clustering notebooks). It is the share of the gene's prediction that the
  feature drives, signed, so the two models' different overall spread drops out.
- **Read the panels for magnitude, not just rank.** A feature's SHAP is largely a function of the
  gene's own feature value, so two models that learned a similar curve line up across genes even
  if they weight the feature very differently. Distance from the dashed y = x line is the
  difference in weight.
- **Colors:** grey70 all genes, black negative controls, orange eIF3d hypoxia targets (drawn last).

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(here) })
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
SAVE <- isTRUE(params$save_plots)
TOL <- 1e-12
feats <- c(log2_utr5_length = "5'UTR length", log2_cds_length = "CDS length", gc3_internal = "GC3")
grp_cols <- c("All genes" = "grey70", "Negative controls" = "black", "eIF3d hypoxia targets" = "#E69F00")
```

# 1. Data and checks

```{r data}
h <- readRDS(file.path(O, paste0("shap_oof_", params$suffix_hyp, ".rds")))
n <- readRDS(file.path(O, paste0("shap_oof_", params$suffix_nor, ".rds")))
stopifnot("duplicate genes" = !anyDuplicated(h$genes$gene_id_clean) && !anyDuplicated(n$genes$gene_id_clean),
          "the two models explain different genes" = setequal(h$genes$gene_id_clean, n$genes$gene_id_clean),
          "the two models have different features" = identical(colnames(h$S), colnames(n$S)),
          "plotted features missing" = all(names(feats) %in% colnames(h$S)),
          "SHAP rows out of step with genes" = nrow(h$S) == nrow(h$genes) && nrow(n$S) == nrow(n$genes))
# The files store genes in different orders: align normoxia to hypoxia by ID
m <- match(h$genes$gene_id_clean, n$genes$gene_id_clean)
Sh <- h$S; Sn <- n$S[m, ]; gn <- n$genes[m, ]
stopifnot("alignment failed" = identical(h$genes$gene_id_clean, gn$gene_id_clean))

# Additivity: prediction = constant baseline + sum of SHAP, per gene
for (x in list(list("hypoxia", h$genes$pred_oof, Sh), list("normoxia", gn$pred_oof, Sn))) {
  b <- x[[2]] - rowSums(x[[3]])
  cat(sprintf("%s: baseline %.4f, sd across genes %.2g\n", x[[1]], mean(b), sd(b)))
  stopifnot("SHAP does not add up to the prediction" = sd(b) < 0.01)
}

# Direction: the outcome files are log2(sictrl / si3d), and the model outcome is their te_lfc
for (f in c(params$de_hyp, params$de_nor)) {
  de <- read_csv(here("output", f), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("[.].*", "", gene_id))
  kd <- de$rna_lfc[de$symbol %in% "EIF3D"]
  stopifnot("EIF3D rna_lfc not > 1: wrong file or flipped direction" = length(kd) == 1 && kd > 1)
  y <- if (f == params$de_hyp) h$genes$y else gn$y
  stopifnot("model outcome is not this file's te_lfc" =
              max(abs(y - de$te_lfc[match(h$genes$gene_id_clean, de$gene_id_clean)])) < TOL)
  cat(sprintf("%s: EIF3D rna_lfc %+.2f; model outcome = te_lfc\n", f, kd))
}

# Gene sets for color: hypoxia targets from the model, checked against the saved gene-set CSV
gs <- sub("[.].*", "", read_csv(here("output", "genesets", params$geneset_hyp), show_col_types = FALSE)$ensembl_gene)
tg <- h$genes$gene_id_clean[h$genes$set == "eIF3d promoted"]
stopifnot("model targets differ from the saved hypoxia gene set" = setequal(tg, intersect(gs, h$genes$gene_id_clean)),
          "negative controls differ between the two models" =
            setequal(h$genes$gene_id_clean[h$genes$set == "negative control"], gn$gene_id_clean[gn$set == "negative control"]))
grp <- factor(case_when(h$genes$set == "eIF3d promoted" ~ "eIF3d hypoxia targets",
                        h$genes$set == "negative control" ~ "Negative controls",
                        TRUE ~ "All genes"), levels = names(grp_cols))
print(table(grp))
cat(sprintf("outcome Spearman, hypoxia vs normoxia = %.3f, n = %s\n",
            cor(h$genes$y, gn$y, method = "spearman"), scales::comma(nrow(Sh))))
```

## Normalized SHAP and spot checks

```{r normalize}
norm_rows <- function(S) S / rowSums(abs(S))
Nh <- norm_rows(Sh); Nn <- norm_rows(Sn)
stopifnot("a gene has zero total |SHAP|" = all(rowSums(abs(Sh)) > 0) && all(rowSums(abs(Sn)) > 0),
          "normalized |SHAP| does not sum to 1 per gene" = max(abs(rowSums(abs(Nh)) - 1), abs(rowSums(abs(Nn)) - 1)) < 1e-10,
          "normalization changed a sign" = all(sign(Nh) == sign(Sh)) && all(sign(Nn) == sign(Sn)))

# Biological direction: each model's SHAP must track its feature the way TE change does
# (longer 5'UTR -> up; longer CDS and more GC3 -> down)
fm <- readRDS(file.path(O, params$matrix_rds))
fv <- sapply(names(feats), function(f) as.numeric(unlist(fm[[f]][match(h$genes$gene_id_clean, fm$gene_id_clean)])))
sc <- expand_grid(model = c("hypoxia", "normoxia"), feature = names(feats)) %>%
  mutate(rho = map2_dbl(model, feature, function(mo, f) {
    s <- if (mo == "hypoxia") Sh[, f] else Sn[, f]; ok <- !is.na(fv[, f])
    cor(fv[ok, f], s[ok], method = "spearman") }))
knitr::kable(sc, digits = 3, caption = "Spearman of each feature's value with its own SHAP, per model")
stopifnot("SHAP direction unexpected" =
            all(sc$rho[sc$feature == "log2_utr5_length"] > 0) && all(sc$rho[sc$feature != "log2_utr5_length"] < 0))

mag <- tibble(feature = feats[names(feats)],
              mean_abs_hyp = colMeans(abs(Sh[, names(feats)])), mean_abs_nor = colMeans(abs(Sn[, names(feats)])),
              share_hyp = colMeans(abs(Nh[, names(feats)])), share_nor = colMeans(abs(Nn[, names(feats)]))) %>%
  mutate(raw_ratio_hyp_over_nor = mean_abs_hyp / mean_abs_nor, share_ratio_hyp_over_nor = share_hyp / share_nor)
knitr::kable(mag, digits = 4, caption = "mean |SHAP| (raw) and mean |share| (normalized) per model; ratio > 1 = weighs more in hypoxia")
```

# 2. Plots

```{r plot_fun}
plot_pair <- function(Hm, Nm, what, file_tag) {
  dd <- map_dfr(names(feats), function(f) tibble(feature = feats[[f]], gene_id_clean = h$genes$gene_id_clean,
                                                  group = grp, x = Nm[, f], y = Hm[, f]))
  dd$feature <- factor(dd$feature, levels = feats)
  st <- dd %>% group_by(feature) %>% summarise(rho = cor(x, y, method = "spearman"), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  stopifnot("every gene in every panel" = all(st$n == nrow(Sh)))
  p <- ggplot(dd %>% arrange(group), aes(x, y, color = group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_text(data = st, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.3f\nn = %s genes", rho, scales::comma(n))),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = grp_cols, name = NULL) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(x = sprintf("%s, normoxia 1+4hr (time-regressed)", what), y = sprintf("%s, hypoxia 1hr", what),
         title = sprintf("MDA-MB-231 eIF3d regression model: %s per gene", what)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
                                          legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p)
  if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", sprintf("47_shap_%s_hypoxia_1hr_vs_normoxia_1and4hr_mda231.pdf", file_tag)), p, width = 13, height = 5)
  st
}
```

## Raw SHAP

```{r raw, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 5}
st_raw <- plot_pair(Sh, Sn, "raw SHAP", "raw")
```

## Normalized SHAP (share of the gene's total |SHAP|)

```{r norm, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 5}
st_norm <- plot_pair(Nh, Nn, "normalized SHAP", "normalized")
knitr::kable(bind_rows(raw = st_raw, normalized = st_norm, .id = "scale"), digits = 3)
```
